title: Molise Pump Prices Climb for a Fourth Straight Day, Diesel Edges Past the National Average
dek: Self-service petrol in Molise still undercuts the rest of Italy, but four consecutive days of gains have pushed diesel just ahead of the national mark.
body: In Molise, self-service Benzina sits at €2.073 per litre and self-service Gasolio at €2.216 as of September 10, according to Fuel Dashboard's latest tracked figures. That puts the region about 1.6 cents below the national self-service Benzina average of €2.0891 — a small but consistent discount — while its Gasolio price has now crept 0.3 cents above the national average of €2.2133, a gap that barely existed a week ago.

The direction of travel is the more striking part of the story: Molise's Benzina price has risen for four straight tracked days, from €2.0519 on September 7 to €2.073 on September 10, a gain of over 2 cents a litre in less than a week, with Gasolio climbing a similar 1.6 cents over the same stretch. Meanwhile the region's station network stayed steady at 175 registered impianti, with 153 reporting prices today — a reporting rate above 87%, a sign the local network kept feeding the system in step with the price moves rather than dropping stations.

Numbers like these — a specific region's four-day price walk, checked against the national average, down to the tenth of a cent — are only realistic to publish every single day because Fuel Dashboard rebuilds itself automatically each morning. There's no analyst re-typing rows into a spreadsheet: the pipeline pulls the fresh MIMIT data, recomputes every region, province, comune and gestore, and hands off a new regional spotlight like this one. It's built with Claude Code, which is exactly the kind of daily-grind automation that turns a one-off dataset into a living dashboard.
pull_quote: Molise's pump prices have climbed for four straight days — Benzina up more than 2 cents a litre since September 7.
caption:
Molise is today's spotlight on Fuel Dashboard: self-service petrol at €2.073/L, still about 1.6 cents below Italy's national average — but diesel has just nudged past it after four straight days of increases.

Fuel Dashboard tracks self-service and served prices for Benzina, Gasolio, GPL and Metano across every Italian region, province, comune and gestore, updated daily. You can explore the full map, filter down to your own comune, and see the national trend at https://adeo-blip.github.io/fuel-price-italy/

What I like most about this project isn't the data itself — it's how it gets published. Instead of a manually maintained Excel sheet that goes stale the moment nobody updates it, the entire pipeline (data ingestion, regional rotation, this article, even the LinkedIn draft you're reading) is generated automatically every morning using Claude Code. AI tools like this are what make a genuinely self-updating, interactive dashboard realistic for a side project instead of a full-time job.
